decisions.reason: Using the Ridgehaven page as a template for future locations does not change the current location selector, selectable locations, or routing behavior.
The template designation does not change the existing requirement that each location have its own website connected through the master site.
The Ridgehaven template strategy does not modify the master-site domain or any domain-to-website mapping.
Reusing the Ridgehaven page as a future template does not change the separate-Wix-account model.
The source's template decision does not alter booking isolation, booking placement, or Ridgehaven's booking activation rule; those are addressed by separate clauses in the same message.
The future-page-template decision does not change the requirement for separate analytics, revenue, or sales reporting.
The template designation does not change Ridgehaven's customer-database isolation requirement.
The template designation does not change Ridgehaven's separate gift-card operations.
The template designation does not change Ridgehaven's separate membership operations.
The template designation does not modify independently controlled Ridgehaven staff access.
The future reuse of the Ridgehaven page is owned by the expansion-template requirement and does not alter the coming-soon page's launch state, sections, buttons, or opening transition.
Making the Ridgehaven page a future-location template does not change the current VIP signup behavior or call-to-action label.
